name: Reaping What You Sow
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that the principle of sowing and reaping is a divine truth reflecting God’s justice and faithfulness. Those who sow wickedness or iniquity will inevitably face corresponding consequences, often described as reaping vanity, the whirlwind, or the rod of anger (Job 4:8; Proverbs 22:8; Hosea 8:7). Conversely, sowing righteousness and generosity promises a sure and abundant reward, bringing joy and blessings in return (Proverbs 11:18; Psalms 126:5; Luke 6:38). This principle underscores the importance of living in obedience to God’s standards, trusting that He measures our actions and responds accordingly.
